messages:
Rachel: heads-up 1: a bundle of customer asks landed around pin economics + migration credits. want to align on a policy we can ship quickly.

Tom: can you list ask types? are these mostly enterprise/legal or broad PLG asks?

Rachel: mix: 1) enterprise customers want paid pin extensions (pay to keep old model for X months). 2) a few smaller ones want auto-sticky pins so their A/B is stable for embeds. 3) some partners request migration credits if we force an upgrade.

Priya: from product POV: paid pin extensions could be a new revenue stream but complicates rollout and benchmarking. auto-sticky is scary for infra.

Marco: infra: sticky pins and paid reservations both drive capacity fragmentation. we can expose a reservation SKU that reserves N qps for a pinned model for the term. that lets us plan capacity, but requires accounting in billing and autoscaler changes.

Rachel: proposed quick policy (MVP):
- Paid pin extension (beta): contract add-on, min 90d, prepaid, creates soft reservation flag in catalog.
- Auto-sticky: disabled by default; available as opt-in for legacy-tenants only.
- Migration credit: 1-time credit if customer migrates within 30d of deprecation notice.

Tom: agree MVP. Need launch criteria and smoke gates: what QA and bench pass do we require before enabling paid pin for a customer?

Priya: suggest launch checklist: 
1) Billing integration test (charges + refunds).
2) Catalog tag + UI to show reserved capacity.
3) Lightweight smoke eval (50 seed prompts) to capture quality baseline.
4) Auto-rollback policy defined.

Marco: infra checklist: 
- reservation token flows, metrics to track reservation utilization,
- fallback path when reserved nodes unhealthy,
- alerting for fragmentation > threshold (we saw 15% perf degradation at 25% fragmentation).

Rachel: also need product gating: a pin should only be approved if smoke eval shows no regression beyond tolerance. propose thresholds: quality-delta <= 3% on key intents, latency p95 < baseline * 1.2.

Tom: can we automate the smoke eval at approval time and store a snapshot in catalog? that would let us compare on future rollouts.

Priya: yes. implement a job that runs the eval against both the pinned and current recommended model and writes results into the model metadata: tag=pinned_snapshot, timestamp.

Marco: timeline ask: we can implement reservation token + metrics in 2 sprints if we scope conservatively (no full autoscaler changes). smoke-eval infra is 1 sprint + small onboarding for QA to define prompts. billing integration depends on payments team but we can mock charge flow initially.

Rachel: OK decisions: ship MVP paid-pin extension as beta with contract add-on + mocked billing; auto-sticky disabled by default; migration-credit as a comms + billing credit which can be manual to start. Launch criteria = all checkboxes above green.

infra-bot: Note: new feature flag "paid_pins_beta" created in feature-service (rollout to 10% orgs).

Tom: next steps:
- Marco: create infra ticket w/ estimate and reserve dev capacity (due EOD).
- Priya: draft smoke-eval prompt set and pass/fail thresholds (tomorrow).
- Rachel: draft beta contract language and comms + a templated migration credit process (end of week).

Rachel: thanks. pulling this into roadmap board as "paid-pin beta" with kickoff Monday. we'll re-evaluate if infra shows high fragmentation risk.

Tom: thanks all. will bring metrics dashboard mock to roadmap sync. :calendar:
